review_method: Change-focused manual lifecycle audit and regression tests; not an independent model review
checks: Reconcile and renew all existing attempts before health-based admission
Unknown reservations and original token checks remain unchanged
Fleet I/O runs off the lease loop; stale/missing/failed observations deny new admission
Every worker RPC still resolves explicit project/node development permission
No fleet auto-enrollment or recipe/policy/capacity expansion
Private health observations only; no credentials or raw logs in source
